# T3 Code patch ledger

Every vendored file Rennet has changed from the pristine snapshot on the `t3-vendor` branch, with why. `pnpm t3:check-ledger` fails on any vendored file that differs from the snapshot and is not listed here. Paths are relative to `vendor/t3code/`. Rennet-owned files inside the tree (`UPSTREAM.json`, this file, `digests/`, any `project.json`, any `tsconfig.rennet.json`) never need a row.

Prefer extension over edit: put Rennet code outside `vendor/` and import their modules. When upstream merges a change listed here, the fold that brings it in removes the row.

| File | Reason | Upstreamable | Upstream PR |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `packages/contracts/src/orchestration.ts` | `thread.turn.start` (both command shapes) and the `thread.turn-start-requested` payload carry an optional `outputSchema`, so a turn can declare a structured-output contract. Rennet's board seats need one JSON board per turn. | yes | pending |
| `packages/contracts/src/provider.ts` | `ProviderSessionStartInput` and `ProviderSendTurnInput` carry `outputSchema`. `ProviderService` re-decodes both and strips unknown keys, so the field has to exist on the schema to survive the hop. | yes | pending |
| `packages/contracts/src/providerRuntime.ts` | `TurnCompletedPayload` carries `structuredOutput` and `durationMs`, the two facts the SDK result frame already reports and T3 dropped. | yes | pending |
| `apps/server/src/orchestration/decider.ts` | Copies the command's `outputSchema` onto the `thread.turn-start-requested` event it emits. | yes | pending |
| `apps/server/src/orchestration/Layers/ProviderCommandReactor.ts` | Threads `outputSchema` from the turn-start event into both `ProviderSessionStartInput` (the session starts on the first turn) and `ProviderSendTurnInput`. | yes | pending |
| `apps/server/src/provider/Layers/ClaudeAdapter.ts` | Sets the SDK's `outputFormat: { type: "json_schema", schema }` from the session's `outputSchema`, remembers the contract on the session context, fails a later turn whose schema the live session cannot serve (the SDK fixes `outputFormat` at `query()` construction and offers no setter) and says which of the two ways it failed, and puts `structured_output`/`duration_ms` from the result frame on `turn.completed`. Also spawns the Claude child through the SDK's `spawnClaudeCodeProcess` hook so its stdin has an `error` listener: the SDK's own transport writes the prompt without one, and a `claude` that dies before that write raised an unhandled `write EPIPE` that killed the whole server process. | yes | pending |
| `apps/server/src/provider/Layers/ProviderService.ts` | `sendTurn` carries the turn's `outputSchema` into the session `resolveRoutableSession`/`recoverSessionForThread` recovers from a persisted resume cursor. Claude's SDK fixes `outputFormat` when the query is built, so a session recovered without it could never serve the turn that asked for the recovery: the adapter refused the turn as a schema mismatch, against a contract identical to the thread's own. | yes | pending |
| `apps/server/src/provider/Layers/ProviderService.test.ts` | Covers the recovery above: a stale `claudeAgent` session recovered for a turn starts on that turn's output schema. | yes | pending |
| `apps/server/src/provider/Layers/CodexAdapter.ts` | Forwards a turn's `outputSchema` to the Codex session runtime. | yes | pending |
| `apps/server/src/provider/Layers/CodexSessionRuntime.ts` | `buildTurnStartParams` passes `outputSchema` through to `V2TurnStartParams.outputSchema`, which the generated protocol already carries and T3 was dropping. | yes | pending |
| `apps/server/src/orchestration/Layers/ProviderRuntimeIngestion.ts` | Projects a `turn.settled` activity from `turn.completed`, carrying the settled turn's structured output, duration, usage and cost. Nothing else in the projection carried a turn's own result, so a reader over `orchestration.subscribeThread` could not see it. | yes | pending |
| `apps/server/src/provider/Layers/ClaudeAdapter.test.ts` | Covers the new adapter behaviours above: the schema becomes the SDK's `outputFormat`, no schema means no output format, a turn asking for a different contract than its session is refused, a turn arriving on a session that holds no contract is refused as that rather than as a mismatch, and the spawn hook terminates a child whose stdin breaks instead of letting the EPIPE escape. | yes | pending |
